run.command: e="{gf_paper_era_code}"; if [ "$e" = 1 ]; then cp -rf "${GF_ERA_DIR:-/opt/gf_paper_era}/." ./; elif [ "$e" != 0 ]; then d="${GF_ERA_REL:-/tmp/gf_era}/$e"; [ -d "$d" ] || "${PYTHON:-python}" gf_harness/era_fetch.py "$e" "$d" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "GF_ERA_FETCH_FAIL $e" >&2; cp -rf "$d/." ./; fi; v="{gf_paper_year_env}"; if [ "$v" != 0 ]; then gf_pip() { if [ -n "$GF_PIP" ]; then $GF_PIP "$@"; else "${PYTHON:-python}" -m pip "$@"; fi; }; [ "$v" = 1 ] && v=all; r="${GF_PY_ROOT:-/opt/gf_py}"; [ "$v" = all ] && v="$(ls "$r" 2>/dev/null | tr "\n" ",")"; GF_LIB_DIRS=""; for p in $(echo "$v" | tr "," " "); do case "$p" in *==*) d="${GF_PY_REL:-/tmp/gf_py}/$p"; case "$p" in torch==*|torchvision==*|torchaudio==*) ix="--index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu";; *) ix="";; esac; [ -d "$d" ] || PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 gf_pip install -q --no-deps $ix --target "$d" "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "GF_LIB_INSTALL_FAIL $p" >&2;; *) d="$r/$p";; esac; GF_LIB_DIRS="${GF_LIB_DIRS:+$GF_LIB_DIRS|}$d"; done; export GF_LIB_DIRS; fi; mkdir -p out; rm -f out/run*.log; export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS=1 TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS=1; GF_SEED=$("${PYTHON:-python}" -c "import os, zlib; print(zlib.crc32(os.environ.get('RUN_TAG', 'x').encode('utf-8')) % 100000)"); n=0; for r in $(seq 1 3); do (timeout ${GF_TIME_CUT:-0} "${GF_BASH:-bash}" -c 'cd src && PYTHONPATH="$OLDPWD${PYTHONPATH:+${GF_PATHSEP:-:}$PYTHONPATH}" "${PYTHON:-python}" main.py --dataset {dataset} --dim {dim} --n_hop {n_hop} --kge_weight {kge_weight} --l2_weight {l2_weight} --lr {lr} --batch_size {batch_size} --n_epoch {n_epoch} --n_memory {n_memory} --item_update_mode {item_update_mode}') > out/run$r.log 2>&1 & n=$((n+1)); if [ $((n % 3)) -eq 0 ]; then wait; fi; done; wait; "${PYTHON:-python}" gf_harness/emit.py
